title: No player-facing way to Equip a standalone Equipment on board to a unit
expected: The only engine path that attaches an equipment already on board is `equipCard` (packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/equipment.ts:50-151), which defines only `condition` + `reducer` and no `enumerator` (and pays no Equip cost). Core enumerateMoves treats enumerator-less moves as an invalid NO_ENUMERATOR placeholder (packages/core/src/engine/rule-engine.ts:970-984), so equipCard never appears as a valid available move. The `activateAbility` enumerator only collects abilities with `ability.type === "activated"` (chain/activate-ability.ts:101-105), while the parsed Equip ability is `{ type: "keyword", keyword: "Equip", cost }` (e.g. riftbound-cards the-zero-drive.ts:26; only consumer is the Weaponmaster pending-choice at pending-choice.ts:188), so no activateAbility entry is generated for Doran's Blade. UI drag-drop only handles equipment dragged from hand via playGear (apps/riftbound-app/public/js/gameplay/drag-drop.js:333-349, gated on `dragState.zone === "hand"`), and play-gear.ts reducer only passes chosenTargetId to deductCost without attaching. Hence no player-facing Equip action for a standalone equipment in base.
observed: enumerateMoves listed no equipCard/activateAbility for the equipment; playGear with chosenTargetId=Gearhead also left it unattached in base. Only the non-enumerated raw REST 'equipCard' move could attach it.

history.note: equipCard gains an enumerator so [Equip] is a player-facing action (rule 579 honoured)

resolution.note: equipCard gains an enumerator so [Equip] is a player-facing action (rule 579 honoured)
